title: Petition by New England Telephone and Telegraph Company respectfully requesting that public convenience and necessity require locations in portions of a public way in the City of Chelsea, namely, Revere Beach Parkway, for approximately 574 feet of underground conduit and cable therein, along the southerly side of Washington Ave. from manhole #63 to manhole #63A of which approximately 150 feet crosses Revere Beach Parkway. Said conduit to be used for the transmission of intelligence and to be owned by your petitioner. Said Revere Beach Parkway is under the care and control of the Metropolitan District Commission.
